familyRequests.done: My son don come. Sit down, make I bring water.

familyRequests.blurb: Buy suya for Chioma at a kiosk / Yaba.

familyRequests.done: You try! This suya sweet die.

familyRequests.title: School levy
familyRequests.blurb: Chioma needs ₦8,000 for a school levy.
familyRequests.msg: School levy is ₦8,000. Daddy no dey around. You fit help?
familyRequests.done: Thank you jare. I no go disappoint you for school.

familyRequests.title: Sunday visit
familyRequests.msg: After church we dey wait you. Come eat with family.
familyRequests.done: Family wey stay together. Go well, my son.

familyRequests.title: Bring drinking water
familyRequests.blurb: Mama needs drinking water at home.
familyRequests.msg: My son, abeg bring sachet water when you dey come. NEPA don affect our pumping machine.
familyRequests.done: Thank you. Cold water fit solve plenty wahala.
